title: SpaceX Seeks to Raise $40 Billion From Apollo to Buy Nvidia Chips
text:
SpaceX, the AI and rocket company led by Elon Musk, is seeking to raise $40 billion to buy Nvidia chips in a financing round led by Apollo Global Management, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday.
